svg.text: R2c copying itself, re-run in rndp for this report (each machine is 262 cells to the right of its parent)
tick 40: the seed (parent only, held in reset)
tick 5 M: child placed and ROM programmed, copper about 40 % laid
tick 10 M: child complete and running; it has placed the grandchild
tick 15 M: grandchild copper about 55 % laid
tick 20 M: grandchild complete; great-grandchild placed
